explanation:
The central tree retains the six conceptual branches while shrinking from 137 to 103 lines (24.8%) and from 9,838 to 7,297 characters (25.8%). Six peripheral trees expand binding decisions, evidence joins, filesystem access, UI state, language sessions and repository registration. [M] means modular structure, [C] call flow, [O] ownership and lifetime, and [D] data dependency; [R] identifies mapped resources. These perspectives are mixed where they explain the same concept. Edges attach to the relevant central nodes, including a second connection to the evidence tree's display-model algorithm. Positions use measured text dimensions, with at least 23 empty columns between the central tree and either peripheral column.

Corrections established by the supplied source: domain/mapping/code-panel/codePanel.ts compares incoming start lines with the last merged display range's start, not necessarily the previous input's start. infrastructure/core/language-services/projectLanguageService.ts accepts omitted positionEncoding and rejects explicitly non-UTF-16 values; its session map belongs to each service instance, so universal sharing across panes is not established. src/features/mapping/code-panel/CodePanel.tsx takes CodePanelPaneContent containing content.panel, and its service calls use structured arguments. application/core/source/projectSource.ts likewise accepts a combined definitions input object. Those signatures and boundaries are corrected in the central tree.

Additional source-grounded detail includes representation validation even with a live diagram, deferred binding checks, duplicate-origin handling, scroll restoration, root canonicalization versus descendant symlink rejection, per-call Git reference caching, comparisonBase null handling, and refusal of language-server edits. Binding details come from application/core/source/diagramSource.ts and projectSource.ts; corpus details from application/core/corpus/corpusAccess.ts and infrastructure/core/corpus/corpus.ts; registry details from infrastructure/core/persistence/repositoryRegistry.ts.

Only context.json and seed.json supplied implementation evidence. Imported helpers and service wiring are not provided: resource-resolution traversal, exact path-validator rules, transport adaptation, Git discovery, hunk capture and atomic-write internals remain unexpanded. Calls and checks shown here do not establish those missing implementations.

Repository Evidence and Navigation
|-- [M] Source identity and access
|   |-- Public entry: ProjectSourceService
|   |   |-- files(projectId, directory, sourceId?) -> directory listing
|   |   |-- source(projectId, path, sourceId?) -> lines + whole-file SHA-256 + lspEnabled
|   |   `-- definitions(input: reference + path/position/sourceSha256, signal) -> results
|   |-- Dependencies: diagram repository/catalogs + CorpusAccess + optional LanguageService
|   `-- [C] resolveDiagramSource(reference, corpus?, liveDiagram?)
|       |-- loadProject() -> require matching projectId
|       |-- representationId supplied -> validate representation and requested/current revision
|       |-- Choose diagram
|       |   |-- live diagram -> validate diagram and optional contentId
|       |   |-- saved representation -> sceneFromRevision() -> exactly one matching content
|       |   `-- neither -> collect catalog bindings + project.sources
|       |       `-- require one distinct binding -> temporary source-query diagram
|       |-- supplied sourceId must match the diagram's binding
|       `-- Return diagramSource query + diagram + binding()/readText()/listFiles()
|           `-- reads/listings -> CorpusAccess.provider(binding.corpus)
|               `-- Project alone does not determine a repository
|-- [D] Selected nodes -> mapped source evidence
|   |-- Required inputs
|   |   |-- diagram content + selected nodes + projectId
|   |   `-- diagramSource(diagram).entries(): mapping + entity + captured range + binding
|   |-- Integrity gate: sourceContext.contentHash == content.asciiSha256
|   |   `-- mismatch -> reject stale diagram mappings before resolving selections
|   |-- [C] handleNodeSelect() -> resolveSelectedNodes()
|   |   |-- sort selections by diagram line, then column
|   |   |-- internal sourceRangeIndex() joins mappings to content node IDs
|   |   |-- resolveNodeResources(content nodes, selected IDs, direct index)
|   |   |   `-- matches + unmappedNodeIds; attach selected-node and mapped-node labels/IDs
|   |   `-- deduplicate by resource identity; append every matching origin
|   |-- Resource identity [R]
|   |   |-- type + projectId + sourceId + path + inclusive one-based start/end lines
|   |   `-- rangeSha256 = SHA-256(captured originalLines joined with LF)
|   |-- PanelContent
|   |   |-- diagramId + revisionId + contentHash + selected/unmapped node IDs
|   |   `-- unique resources [R] + origins(selected node, mapped node, mappingId)
|   `-- [M] Pure mapping boundary
|       `-- Exposes selection/identity/display helpers; no React or file I/O
|-- [M] Corpus access
|   |-- Contract: CorpusAccess
|   |   `-- provider(binding), readDocumentLines(binding, path), discover(inputPath, profile)
|   |-- Adapter: corpusProvider(binding) -> provider selected by corpus kind
|   |   `-- git-worktree and filesystem-documents share internal FilesystemCorpusProvider
|   |-- Internal path boundary
|   |   |-- canonicalize root; require expected kind and an existing directory
|   |   `-- validate relative segments; reject symlink traversal and root escape
|   `-- [C] Filesystem operations
|       |-- listDirectory -> validate directory -> read entries -> omit .git -> directories first
|       |-- readDocumentBytes -> validate regular file -> readFile
|       `-- readLines(range) -> validate positive inclusive bounds -> slice available lines
|-- [M] CodePanel browsing experience
|   |-- Public CodePanel takes CodePanelPaneContent; dispatches content.panel by type
|   |   `-- source-range -> SourceResources -> SourceRangeSections
|   |-- [D] Display sections = ordered resources [R] + buildSourceRangeDisplayModel()
|   |   `-- retain input order; split sections or merge overlaps; preserve contributing items
|   |-- [C] Mount/reload -> codeRepo.readFile(repo, path, {signal, reload})
|   |   |-- pending -> loading state; failure -> error + Retry
|   |   `-- loaded -> normalize line endings -> check each captured range [R]
|   |       |-- [D] range freshness needs current slice + captured rangeSha256
|   |       |   `-- range past EOF or hash mismatch -> stale notice replaces mapped code
|   |       `-- fresh -> SourceCodeView: mapped ranges, folded gaps and origin annotations
|   |-- [C] Browse source / definition result -> SourceCodePane
|   |   |-- keep projectId and sourceId; use chosen location's path when supplied
|   |   `-- Back returns to mapped ranges; changed PanelContent clears navigation
|   `-- [O] UI state and request lifetime
|       |-- section retains loaded file, errors, definition choices and request controllers
|       |-- effect cleanup aborts file read and definition request; aborted results are ignored
|       `-- cleanup removes highlights/listeners, observer and scroll subscription
|-- [M] Definition navigation
|   |-- UI calls codeRepo.definitions(repo, {path, position, sourceSha256}, {signal})
|   |   `-- enabled for supported files when the loaded response reports lspEnabled
|   |-- Application boundary: ProjectSourceService.definitions()
|   |   |-- absent LanguageService -> lsp-disabled error
|   |   `-- resolve source binding -> LanguageService.definitions(binding.corpus, ...)
|   |-- [D] Valid lookup needs current file text + displayed whole-file hash + position
|   |   |-- ProjectLanguageService reads through corpusProvider(binding)
|   |   |-- require supported TS/JS path and nonnegative integer position
|   |   |-- disk SHA-256 must equal supplied sourceSha256; otherwise require reload
|   |   `-- position must be within current text; LSP uses zero-based UTF-16 coordinates
|   |-- [C] ProjectLanguageService.definitions() -> LanguageSession.lookup()
|   |   |-- canonical root -> reuse/create session -> queued didOpen/definition/didClose
|   |   `-- normalize returned locations
|   |       |-- non-file or rejected relative paths -> count in outsideRoot
|   |       `-- accepted locations -> root-relative paths; deduplicate path/range pairs
|   `-- [O] Language-service resources
|       |-- service instance owns sessions keyed by canonical root
|       |-- internal session owns child process, JSON-RPC connection, queue and timers
|       |-- initialization/definition request timeout: 20 seconds -> dispose session
|       |-- idle timer: 5 minutes -> dispose; later lookup replaces a dead session
|       `-- disposal is idempotent: clear timer, dispose RPC, terminate child/process group
`-- [M] Registered Git repositories and change evidence
    |-- Public API: initialize/list/register + resolveCheckoutRoot/resolveContext/captureHunks
    |-- [D] Repository record = discovered Git identity + name + known checkout roots
    |   |-- stable repository ID derives from SHA-256(repositoryIdentity)
    |   `-- register merges checkout roots for the same identity
    |-- [C] Resolve repository context
    |   |-- explicit repositoryId, or the only registered repository -> choose record
    |   |-- resolve head, commits and optional comparisonBase to verified commit SHAs
    |   `-- captureHunks(context) -> validate context -> matching checkout -> captureGitHunks
    `-- [O] Registry writes
        |-- shared queue keyed by project.json serializes initialization/registration
        `-- atomic-write helper persists records; release queue entry if still current

Source binding decisions
|-- [C] resolveDiagramSource: guards precede selection
|   |-- loadProject must exist and match ref.projectId
|   `-- representationId requires a catalog record and a member revision
|       `-- applies even when a liveDiagram is supplied
|-- [D] Diagram choice, in priority order
|   |-- liveDiagram: validate; compare optional contentId to diagram.id
|   |-- saved revision: sceneFromRevision -> filter contents
|   |   |-- contentId supplied: match that ID
|   |   `-- otherwise: retain bound contents; require exactly one candidate
|   `-- no live/saved diagram: catalog bindings + project.sources
|       |-- filter by optional sourceId; deduplicate by sourceId
|       |-- same ID with different root, kind or repositoryIdentity: reject
|       `-- exactly one binding: createStoredDiagram("source-query", revision 0)
|-- [M] Returned access boundary
|   |-- supplied sourceId must match the chosen diagram binding
|   |-- binding() rejects missing binding when called
|   `-- readText/listFiles require CorpusAccess, then call its provider
|       `-- choosing a diagram alone need not establish readable source
`-- [C] ProjectSourceService.source
    |-- missing sourcePath: invalid-input; null projectId becomes ""
    |-- resolve binding -> read current text -> reject NUL as binary-source
    `-- return path, startLine 1, split lines, raw-text SHA-256, lspEnabled

Mapped evidence and ordered display
|-- [D] sourceRangeIndex joins diagramSource entries
|   |-- reject contentHash != asciiSha256 before building resources
|   |-- missing node ID, entity or range: skip entry
|   `-- sourceId: entity.sourceId ?? binding.sourceId ?? ""
|-- [D] Resource identity includes captured content
|   |-- type + projectId + sourceId + path + startLine + endLine
|   `-- plus SHA-256(originalLines joined with LF)
|       `-- same coordinates with different captured hashes remain distinct
|-- [C] handleNodeSelect
|   |-- sort nodes by line, then startColumn
|   |-- resolveSelectedNodes -> resolveNodeResources -> attach origin labels
|   |-- combine identical resources; append origins without deduplicating them
|   `-- selectedNodeIds separately deduplicated with Set
|-- [C] buildSourceRangeDisplayModel scans supplied item order
|   |-- new section if projectId/sourceId/path differs from current section
|   |-- also if incoming start < last merged display range's start
|   |   `-- not a comparison with the immediately preceding input start
|   |-- start <= previous end: extend end with max; append contributing item
|   `-- otherwise add a range; adjacent nonoverlapping ranges stay separate
`-- [D] UI freshness is checked per original contributing item
    |-- normalize CRLF and lone CR to LF in loaded text
    |-- inclusive one-based slice -> LF join -> compare captured range hash
    |-- any end past EOF or mismatch hides the section's mapped code
    `-- whole-file hash is instead sent with definition requests

Filesystem corpus boundary
|-- [M] CorpusAccess exposes provider, line reads and discovery
|   `-- concrete discovery wiring is outside the supplied files
|-- [O] Provider table retains one object per corpus kind
|   `-- git-worktree and filesystem-documents use the same internal class
|-- [C] Resolve a file or directory
|   |-- binding kind must match provider kind
|   |-- realpath(binding.root) -> require existing directory
|   |   `-- canonicalizes the root; does not ban a symlink at the root itself
|   |-- relative path rejects NUL, backslash, absolute and dot/parent segments
|   |   `-- empty string represents root; nonempty paths reject empty segments
|   `-- lstat each descendant segment; reject missing paths or any symlink
|       `-- final resolved path must remain at or beneath canonical root
|-- [C] listDirectory
|   |-- require directory; omit entries named .git
|   |-- symlink entries appear as files, but cannot be read through this provider
|   `-- sort directories first, then case-insensitive name, then path
`-- [C] Reading
    |-- readDocumentBytes: require regular file -> readFile
    |-- text decodes UTF-8; lines split on optional CR followed by LF
    |-- readLines: integer bounds, start >= 1, end >= start; clamp slice at EOF
    `-- .git exclusion is a listing rule, not a read-path prohibition

CodePanel state and interaction
|-- [O] SourceRangeSections owns each section's requests
|   |-- effect depends on codeRepo, file.id and retry attempt
|   |-- clear loaded/error; readFile with a fresh AbortController
|   |-- attempt differs from loadedAttempt: pass reload = true
|   `-- cleanup aborts file read and current definition request
|-- [C] Definition lookup
|   |-- abort prior lookup; clear choices; show pending message
|   |-- ignore aborted completion; one location opens source
|   `-- several locations become choices; zero or error becomes a message
|       `-- returned outsideRoot count is not displayed here
|-- [D] Origin annotations
|   |-- display one origin per selectedNodeId using a Map
|   |-- show mapped label as "via" when mapped and selected IDs differ
|   `-- annotation hover highlights selected nodes; cleanup clears attributes
|-- [O] Panel navigation retains project/source identity and optional location
|   `-- Back or changed content.panel clears navigation
`-- [O] Scroll state binds documentId + pane id + "@code-panel"
    |-- restore only when a mounted scroll element exists and document is active
    |-- ResizeObserver reapplies saved offsets as loaded sections gain height
    |-- finish restoration once no resource reports loading; wheel stops it
    |-- subscription returns saved position while restoring
    |   `-- otherwise reports offsets only when element has client rectangles
    `-- cleanup disconnects observer/subscription and removes wheel listener

Definition session protocol and lifetime
|-- [D] ProjectLanguageService validates before session lookup
|   |-- reject disposed service, aborted signal, unsupported path or position
|   |-- read corpus text; compare SHA-256 with displayed whole-file hash
|   `-- zero-based line must exist; character may equal line.length
|-- [O] sessions map belongs to each service instance
|   |-- canonical root key -> reuse live session; replace missing/dead session
|   `-- module liveSessions set supports process signal cleanup
|-- [C] New LanguageSession
|   |-- spawn typescript-language-server via Node, using root as cwd
|   |-- initialize with UTF-16 capability and TypeScript tsserver path
|   |-- require definitionProvider; reject explicitly non-UTF-16 encoding
|   |   `-- omitted positionEncoding is accepted
|   `-- workspace/applyEdit returns applied: false
|-- [C] Serialized lookup
|   |-- failed previous work does not poison the queue
|   |-- await ready -> check alive/abort -> didOpen(version 1, current text)
|   |-- textDocument/definition uses CancellationTokenSource
|   `-- finally remove abort listener, dispose token, didClose if alive
|-- [D] Result normalization
|   |-- prefer targetUri over uri; targetSelectionRange over range
|   |-- non-file URI or rejected root-relative path increments outsideRoot
|   `-- deduplicate serialized path/range objects
`-- [O] Disposal
    |-- 20-second bounds cover initialize and definition request individually
    |-- 5-minute idle timer; queue wait is not wrapped by bounded()
    |-- idempotently mark dead, remove live-set entry, clear idle, dispose RPC
    |-- SIGTERM child PID on Windows, child process group elsewhere
    `-- service disposal clears its map and removes its process-exit listener

Registered Git identities and change context
|-- [D] discover(root, name)
|   |-- ID = "repo-" + first 24 hex characters of SHA-256(repositoryIdentity)
|   `-- name = trimmed input or checkout basename; retain discovered checkout
|-- [C] initialize / register
|   |-- initialize skips backfill if repositories is already defined, even []
|   |-- else inspect current checkout plus git-worktree source roots
|   |   `-- skip discovery failures; combine roots for identical repository IDs
|   `-- register discovers first, initializes, then merges roots inside queue
|       `-- name precedence: explicit trimmed name, prior name, discovered name
|-- [C] availableRoot
|   |-- try saved checkout roots, then current checkout; deduplicate candidates
|   `-- accept first discoverable matching identity or report unavailable
|-- [C] resolveContext
|   |-- choose explicit repositoryId or the sole registered repository
|   |-- resolve head, default HEAD, with git rev-parse
|   |   `-- --verify --end-of-options and ref^{commit}
|   |-- cache resolved refs within this call; deduplicate commit SHAs with Set
|   `-- comparisonBase: absent stays absent; null stays null; string resolves
|-- [C] captureHunks
|   `-- parse context -> find repository -> availableRoot -> captureGitHunks
`-- [O] Module queue keyed by project.json path
    |-- serializes initialization and registration across registry instances
    |-- prior rejection is caught so later work still runs
    |-- writeJsonAtomic is the imported persistence boundary
    `-- finally delete queue entry only if it still holds this operation
